frontmatter_text:
Reductive Groups
J. S. Milne
March 10, 2018, v2.00
Abstract
These notes are a guide to algebraic groups, especially reductive groups, over a
field. Proofs are usually omitted or only sketched. The only prerequisite is a basic
knowledge of commutative algebra and the language of modern algebraic geometry.
My goal in these notes is to write a modern successor to the review articles Springer
1979, 1994.
Caution: These notes will be revised without warning (the numbering may change).
